The room of the Oracle

If you are wise enough you may leave this isle and explore the great continent of Tibia. Once you are at level eight you may talk to the Oracle who will send you to the continent.

The room of the Oracle

When the Oracle talks with you, you are asked two questions. First you may choose a city where you want to start your journey. Then you may select the vocation you want to follow. Choose wisely!
